generationInputs.prompt: A vibrant, modern illustration features a heart shape meticulously crafted from a medley of colorful vegetables: ripe red tomatoes, bright orange carrots, verdant broccoli florets, and deep blue blueberries, intricately intertwined. A graceful heart shape, outlined by lush green leaves, frames the vegetable heart, creating a visually stunning contrast. Beside the main heart, a playful half-heart shape made of the same vegetables adds a touch of whimsy. The whole composition is rendered in a clean, crisp style against a pristine white background, emphasizing the vivid colors and textures of the vegetables and leaves. The illustration is infused with a bright, cheerful energy and evokes a feeling of health and vitality.
